title: Planner: add times to task start, finish and due dates
summary: The briefing accurately separates the roadmap's planned task-time changes from the documented beta calendar API. Its controls and product licensing statements are supported, and the remaining feature-specific defaults and licensing gaps are appropriately qualified.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Open questions; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the arrival default for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner task times plan time zone working hours default rollout existing tasks administrator settings; "Planner" "times" "default" "570153". Read roadmap, Planner for admins, manage-planner-app and beta calendar references; no feature arrival default.

claims.claim: A UI route for this feature's plan time zone, working hours and default task times is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner plan time zone working hours settings user interface change time zone default task times; "Planner" "time zone" "working hours" "settings". Read Planner admin and Teams management pages and beta planCalendar/workDayDefaults; no matching UI route.

claims.claim: Who can set the feature's plan time zone and working hours is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner plan calendar timeZone workDayDefaults permissions who can update plan types Power Automate connector. Read beta Update plan and calendar references and Planner for admins; no configurable user role is named, and the operation lists permissions as Not supported.

claims.claim: The actual default task-time values for this feature are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner task times plan time zone working hours default rollout existing tasks administrator settings. Read roadmap and beta planCalendar/workDayDefaults; they define default-time properties without specifying initial clock times for this feature.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether this change modifies existing tasks or dates.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner task times plan time zone working hours default rollout existing tasks administrator settings; "Planner" "times" "default" "570153". Read roadmap, Planner for admins and beta task/calendar/update references; none states migration of existing task dates.

claims.claim: The roadmap feature's plan-type coverage is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner plan calendar timeZone workDayDefaults permissions who can update plan types Power Automate connector. Read roadmap, Planner for admins, service description and beta task/calendar references; beta types identify unified plans, not full roadmap-feature plan coverage.

claims.where: licensing.notes; summary; Cost and licensing; Scope; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A licence rule specifically for adding task times and the associated plan settings is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner add times start finish due dates licensing price meter premium licence. Read Planner for admins, Planner subscriptions and service description; they give product licences and neighbouring capabilities, not a licence rule for this task-time feature.

claims.claim: No price or meter specifically for this feature is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner add times start finish due dates licensing price meter premium licence; "Planner" "plans_v2" "metered" calendar pricing; Microsoft Graph metered APIs services Planner pricing plans calendar. Read admin/licensing/service pages, beta Update plan and Graph metered API list.

claims.claim: Whether a tenant administrator can centrally set or lock these plan settings remains an open question.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner task times plan time zone working hours default rollout existing tasks administrator settings; Planner plan calendar timeZone workDayDefaults permissions who can update plan types Power Automate connector. Read Planner admin pages and beta Update plan; no tenant lock documented.

claims.claim: The beta plan calendar has a timeZone property describing the plan calendar's time zone.
claims.quote: timeZone | String | Time zone the plan's calendar is expressed in.

claims.claim: The plan calendar's workDayDefaults property holds default working-day start and end times.
claims.quote: The calendar property of the plan resource uses this type. ... workDayDefaults | workDayDefaults | Default working-day start and end times for the plan.

claims.claim: calendar.workDayDefaults.startTime is the default working-day start-time property.
claims.quote: The workDayDefaults property of the planCalendar resource uses this type. ... startTime | TimeOfDay | Default start time of the working day.

claims.claim: calendar.workDayDefaults.endTime is the default working-day end-time property.
claims.quote: The workDayDefaults property of the planCalendar resource uses this type. ... endTime | TimeOfDay | Default end time of the working day.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Planner > Block turns off the Planner app at organisation level.
claims.quote: In the left pane of the Teams admin center, go to Teams apps > Manage apps. ... To turn off Planner for your organization, search for the Planner app, select it, and then select Block.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app-id> -IsBlocked <boolean> changes the app's tenant state.
claims.quote: Module: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module. ... Update-M365TeamsApp ... -Id <String> ... [-IsBlocked <Boolean>] ... -Id: Application ID of Microsoft Teams app. ... -IsBlocked: The state of the app in the tenant.

claims.claim: The reference types IsBlocked as Boolean.
claims.quote: -IsBlocked ... The state of the app in the tenant. ... Type: | Boolean

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference describes examples using both true and false as unblocking.
claims.quote: Example 3 ... -IsBlocked $true ... Unblocks Bookings app ... Example 4 ... -IsBlocked $false ... Unblocks 1Page App

claims.claim: The Teams app control governs Planner in Teams rather than turning off Planner on the web.
claims.quote: Manage the Planner app for your organization in Microsoft Teams ... You can turn off or turn on the app at the org level on the Manage apps page in the Teams admin center.

claims.claim: The listed tenant app block is a coarse Planner-app control, not a setting for task times or plan working hours.
claims.quote: To turn off Planner for your organization, search for the Planner app, select it, and then select Block.

claims.claim: Settings and policies configured for Planner on the web also apply to Planner in Teams.
claims.quote: Settings and policies that you configure for Planner for web will also apply to Planner in Teams.

claims.claim: The v1.0 plannerTask startDateTime property is a date-and-time value in UTC.
claims.quote: startDateTime | DateTimeOffset | Date and time at which the task starts. The Timestamp type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC time.

claims.claim: The v1.0 plannerTask dueDateTime property is a date-and-time value in UTC.
claims.quote: dueDateTime | DateTimeOffset | Date and time at which the task is due. The Timestamp type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC time.

claims.claim: The beta Planner Unified plans task resource types startDateTime as dateWithOptionalTime.
claims.quote: A task in the Planner Unified plans Graph API. ... startDateTime | dateWithOptionalTime | Date and, optionally, time the task is scheduled to start.

claims.claim: The beta Planner Unified plans task resource types dueDateTime as dateWithOptionalTime.
claims.quote: dueDateTime | dateWithOptionalTime | Date and, optionally, time the task is due.
